name: Merri Creek Planting Day
description: Join us for a morning of native tree planting along the Merri Creek corridor. All tools and refreshments provided.

name: Fitzroy Pocket Park Build
description: Help us transform an unused lot in Fitzroy into a vibrant community pocket park with native plantings.

name: Native Grass Seed Collection
description: Learn about native grasses and help collect seeds for our revegetation nursery program.

name: Yarra Bank Weed Removal
description: Help restore the Yarra riverbank by removing invasive weeds and planting native ground cover.

name: Schoolyard Greening Workshop
description: A hands-on workshop for teachers and parents on creating green spaces in schoolyards.

name: Westgate Park Revegetation
description: Continue the award-winning revegetation program at Westgate Park with new native plantings.

name: Darebin Creek Bird Habitat Restoration
description: Help create habitat corridors for native birds along the Darebin Creek with understorey planting.

name: Carlton Rooftop Garden Project
description: Meet at Argyle Square, then join our pilot rooftop garden project transforming an inner-city building into a green oasis.

name: Indigenous Plants Walk & Talk
description: A guided walk with an Indigenous elder exploring traditional uses of native plants in the Melbourne region.

name: Edinburgh Gardens Tree Health Check
description: Help our arborists mulch, water and check the health of young trees planted in Edinburgh Gardens last winter.

name: Albert Park Lake Shoreline Planting
description: Plant reeds and native shrubs along the lake edge to reduce erosion and give waterbirds more shelter.

name: Pollinator Patch Planting
description: Create a patch of native flowering plants that supports bees, butterflies and other pollinating insects.

name: Footscray Park Community Garden Day
description: Build raised garden beds and plant vegetables and herbs for the local community garden.

name: Maribyrnong River Revegetation
description: Plant river red gums and understorey species along the Maribyrnong River in Brimbank Park.

name: Saltmarsh Habitat Care
description: Remove weeds and protect fragile coastal saltmarsh, home to migratory shorebirds.

name: Kids Nature Discovery Trail
description: A family-friendly trail where children learn to identify native plants, birds and insects.

name: Herring Island Bushland Day
description: Take the punt to Herring Island and help care for its remnant bushland and sculpture park.

name: Elsternwick Park Wetland Planting
description: Plant wetland species in the new Elsternwick Park nature reserve along Elster Creek.

name: Banyule Flats Birdwatch & Survey
description: Join local birders to record waterbirds on the Banyule billabong and add sightings to citizen science records.

name: Ruffey Lake Park Planting Day
description: Plant indigenous trees and shrubs to extend wildlife corridors around Ruffey Lake.

name: Jells Park Frog Habitat Survey
description: A small-group evening survey with ecologists, listening for and recording frog calls around the Jells Park wetlands.

name: Queens Park Weed Busters
description: Remove invasive weeds from garden beds and the lake edge so native plants can thrive.

name: Composting & Worm Farm Workshop
description: Learn how to turn food scraps into compost and set up a worm farm at home.

name: Coastal Dune Restoration
description: Stabilise coastal dunes by planting native grasses and removing weeds along the Point Cook foreshore.
